steps.en: Install Whiteboard Desktop; it puts the whiteboard CLI on your PATH
steps.zh: 安装桌面应用，它会顺带装好 whiteboard CLI

steps.en: Desktop hosts a local server that owns review state, the canvas and agent setup
steps.zh: 桌面应用在本机起服务，托管评审状态、画布与 agent 接入

steps.en: Run the connect command and paste its generated prompt into your agent
steps.zh: 运行 connect 命令，把生成的提示词贴给你的 agent

steps.en: The agent adds the whiteboard MCP server, which serves the authoring instructions
steps.zh: agent 注册 whiteboard MCP 服务，由它下发编写规范

steps.en: Ask your agent to review the branch against main and say: use whiteboard
steps.zh: 让 agent 评审当前分支相对 main，并叮嘱 use whiteboard

steps.en: It pins the commits, reads the diff, and draws sections, diagrams and code links live
steps.zh: 它钉住提交、读取 diff，在画布上实时绘制章节、图与代码链接

value.en: Read the change as an RFC the agent wrote: click a diagram or quote, land on the exact line in your checkout
value.zh: 你读到的是 agent 亲笔的可交互 RFC——点图或引文，直接落到本地代码的那一行

sources: packages/review/onboarding.md steps 1-4: install Desktop (installs `whiteboard` CLI); Desktop hosts the JSON review server; `whiteboard connect <agent>` + paste prompt -> agent adds Whiteboard MCP server; agent authors via MCP tools or `whiteboard api`
README.md Quickstart: 'Ask your agent to review your current branch against up-to-date main and open the result in Whiteboard'; telemetry example prompt ends 'use whiteboard'

packages/agent-plugins/claude/.mcp.json + packages/review/src/connect-prompts.ts: MCP launch `whiteboard mcp` via $HOME/.local/bin/whiteboard; CLI subcommands (connect/api/mcp/app/trace) in packages/review/src/cli-runner.ts

packages/review/instructions/authoring.md: create whiteboard pinned to commits/PR, 'read the diff with `session_diff`', write what/why + requirements + design + implementation sections incrementally while the user watches
packages/review/README.md: Desktop detects installed agents, installs CLI + skills, writes the shim to ~/.local/bin, re-syncs after app updates
